sources.title: Messelornis cristata fossil profile
sources.author: UNESCO World Heritage Grube Messel, photo Hessisches Landesmuseum Darmstadt
sources.evidence: Official actual fossil photo viewed. About30cm species estimate, long tail, terrestrial woodland bird of moderate flight capability; feather evidence usually poor. Family now interpreted near rails/finfoots.

sources.title: Diet of Messelornis (Aves: Gruiformes), an Eocene bird from Germany
sources.author: Michael Morlo2004, Courier Forschungsinstitut Senckenberg252:29-33
sources.evidence: Author-hosted original5-page paper read and Fig1 actual SMFME3550 skeleton with3cmbar inspected. Tibiotarsus63.4mm, tarsometatarsus55.7mm, inferred male. Bill narrow short with lightly hooked tip; omnivory from fish in esophagus. Historical affinity discussed separately from current taxonomy.

sources.title: New material of Paleocene-Eocene Pellornis clarifies gruiform radiation
sources.author: 2019 primary phylogenetic study
sources.evidence: Comparative Messelornis morphologies and ralloidean relationship; no transfer of Pellornis dimensions to M.cristata.
